response: import uvicorn from fastapi import FastAPI, Response, HTTPException, Request from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import Optional app = FastAPI(title="LoggingAPI", version="1.0.11") LOG_FILE = "logs.txt" # Limit the maximum size of a single log message to prevent resource exhaustion (e.g., 1MB) MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 1 * 1024 * 1024 class LogEntry(BaseModel): # Use Field to enforce a maximum length for the message string message: str = Field(..., max_length=1000000) @app.post("/log", summary="Log a message", description="Log a message to the server.") async def log_message(entry: LogEntry): # Security Fix: Prevent Log Injection. # We must strip or replace Carriage Return (\r) and Line Feed (\n) characters # to ensure one log entry cannot spoof multiple lines in the text file. sanitized_message = entry.message.replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ') try: with open(LOG_FILE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(sanitized_message + "\n") except Exception: # Error handling: return a generic error to avoid leaking internal system details raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error occurred while writing log.") return {"status": "Log message successful"} @app.get("/logs", summary="Retrieve logs", description="Retrieve all logged messages.") async def retrieve_logs(): try: with open(LOG_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f: content = f.read() except FileNotFoundError: content = "" except Exception: # Error handling: return a generic error to avoid leaking internal system details raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error occurred while reading logs.") # The OpenAPI schema specifies text/plain for the response content return Response(content=content, media_type="text/plain") # Middleware to bound request body size to prevent resource exhaustion (DoS) @app.middleware("http") async def limit_request_size(request: Request, call_next): # Check Content-Length header if present content_length = request.headers.get('content-length') if content_length and int(content_length) > MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE * 2: return Response(content="Request entity too large", status_code=413) response = await call_next(request) return response if __name__ == "__main__": uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
